hero.title: Lunch and dinner, ready. All week long.
hero.lead: Evelyn cooks in your kitchen and leaves ready portions in your fridge, each labelled with the dish and the date. You get home and just heat it up.
hero.note: No commitment. Evelyn prepares your quote and gets back to you as soon as possible.
hero.photoAlt: Ceramic plates, olive oil and a tea towel on a wooden table

how.title: How it works
how.intro: Four steps, from your request to a full fridge.
how.step1Text: Tell us how many people and how many weeks, which days and meals, and any allergies. No commitment.
how.step2Text: You get a confirmation email straight away. Then Evelyn gets in touch, suggests a menu and agrees the day and time with you.
how.step3Text: You do the shopping, with the list Evelyn sends you. On the agreed day she cooks in your kitchen: meanwhile you can work, go out or just enjoy the smell.
how.step4Text: Meals are already split into portions, each with the dish name and the date it was made. Just heat and eat.

included.title: What's included
included.item1Text: Home-style recipes, varied and seasonal, chosen around the tastes of whoever sits at your table.
included.item2Text: You do the shopping: before each session Evelyn sends you the list of ingredients, with quantities.
included.item3Text: {minRecipes} to {maxRecipes} recipes per session, made on the spot with fresh ingredients.
included.item4Text: Every portion shows dish and date, so you always know what's in the fridge and what to eat first.
included.item5Text: Recipes take into account the allergies, intolerances and diets you tell us about.
included.photoAlt: {brand} menu: starter, first course, main course and dessert

pricing.title: How you pay
pricing.intro: A quote made for you, always clear. No automatic renewal, no hidden costs.
pricing.serviceText: Evelyn prepares it for your household based on the people, days, meals and weeks you ask for. She sends it by email or WhatsApp and you accept it before we start: no commitment.
pricing.shoppingText: Before each session Evelyn sends you the list of ingredients, with quantities. You only pay her for the service: nothing to advance or pay back for the shopping.
pricing.methodsText: Cash, bank transfer, Satispay or a card payment link: you choose when you confirm.
pricing.ctaTitle: What would it cost for you?
pricing.ctaText: Tell us what you need and Evelyn will prepare your quote.

who.title: Who it's for
who.familiesText: For parents who work all day and still want healthier, home-cooked food on the table.
who.prosText: For anyone who gets home late, has no time to cook and is tired of living on delivery.
who.kidsText: Simple, wholesome dishes, with portions sized for them.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Bergamo and the surrounding area. Put your area in the request and we'll tell you straight away if we can get there.
faq.aPrice: The quote is made for you: Evelyn prepares it based on the people, days, meals and weeks, and sends it by email or WhatsApp. You do the shopping, with the list Evelyn sends you.
faq.aWeeks: Yes, up to {maxWeeks} weeks: each week a menu and a cooking session, on the same day of the week. No automatic renewal: at the end, if you want to carry on, just send a new request.
faq.q2: How long does a session take?
faq.a2: It depends on how many portions and recipes: usually a few hours. You agree the time with Evelyn when she contacts you.
faq.q3: How long do the dishes keep?
faq.a3: Usually 3–4 days in the fridge, depending on the recipe. For later in the week some dishes can be frozen: Evelyn will tell you which. Every portion shows the date it was made.
faq.a4: Simple, varied home cooking: pasta, mains, vegetables, soups. You decide the menu together before each session, based on tastes and season.
faq.a5: No. The quote doesn't commit you until you accept it: Evelyn prepares it after hearing from you, and you only confirm if you're happy with it.
faq.q6: What if I need to cancel?
faq.a6: We'll give you the cancellation terms together with the quote, before you confirm.

final.title: Free evenings, full fridge.
final.text: Tell us what you need. No commitment: Evelyn prepares your quote and gets back to you as soon as possible.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains how we process the personal data you give us through the quote request form on this website and through your booking page, as required by Art. 13 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (the “GDPR”).
privacy.controllerBody:
The controller is Evelyn Ayelen Costa, Bergamo.

Contact: email costaevel03@gmail.com, phone +39 344 793 6567.
privacy.dataBody:
• Contact details: name, phone, email, area or neighbourhood.
  • Request details: type of service, number of adults and children, days, meals, preferred day, the dishes you choose from the menu (if you choose any), notes, the site language and, if you choose it, your request to get the confirmation on WhatsApp too.
  • Quote and menu replies: on your booking page you can accept or decline the quote (the weeks and the service price Evelyn proposes), confirm each week's menu or ask for changes with a message; we keep your reply (accepting or declining the quote, the confirmation or the message), with the date, together with your booking. Don't write allergies or other health information in the message (section 5).
  • Food allergies, intolerances and coeliac disease of the people Evelyn cooks for, children included: the form asks you about them. If you confirm that nobody has any, we keep only that confirmation with your request; if you write them down, we process them with your explicit consent (section 5).
  • Technical data: IP address and some information about your browser and device, used only to protect the form and your booking page from spam and abuse (section 6).

We don't ask for diagnoses or medical records: we only need to know what to avoid in the kitchen.
privacy.purposeBody:
• To prepare and send you the quote and the suggested menu.
  • To show you on the calendar, while you are still filling in the form, the days when Evelyn is free.
  • To confirm that your request has arrived, by email and, if you choose, on WhatsApp too.
  • To organise and carry out the service: the shopping list we send you (you do the shopping), cooking, labelled portions.
  • To show you on your booking page, which you open with the personal link you get with the menu, the quote, the weeks you booked and the menu for each one, and to receive your reply to the quote (acceptance or refusal), your confirmation or change requests.
  • To communicate with you by phone, email or WhatsApp about anything related to the request and the service.
  • To protect the form and your booking page from spam, automated submissions and abuse.
  • To meet tax and accounting obligations, if the service takes place.

We don't use your data for advertising and we don't sell it to anyone.
privacy.legalBody:
• Contact and request details (including your confirmation that nobody has allergies, intolerances or coeliac disease, if you give it), confirmation email, booking page and quote and menu replies (accepting or declining the quote, confirmation or change request): pre-contractual steps and performance of the contract, at your request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
  • Confirmation on WhatsApp: your consent, given with the optional box on the form and withdrawable at any time (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).
  • Allergies and intolerances you write on the form: explicit consent, given with its own box (Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR); for other people's, also their agreement, which you declare with the same box (section 5).
  • Protecting the form and the booking page (spam check and limits on submissions, calendar and menu look-ups, and visits and replies on the booking page): our legitimate interest in preventing spam and abuse (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
  • Tax records: legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR).
privacy.healthBody:
To cook safely, the form asks whether any of the people Evelyn cooks for, children included, has food allergies, intolerances or coeliac disease. You can answer in two ways:

  • Nobody has any: you confirm it with the box, and we keep only that confirmation with your request.
  • You write them down: allergies, intolerances and coeliac disease are health data, so we ask for your separate, explicit consent (Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR), with its own box. You can refuse it: in that case the form can't send your request. Don't tick “nobody has any” because of that: use the contact in section 1, and Evelyn will ask for your consent before noting them down.

If you write down the allergies and intolerances of other people (family members or guests), you must have told them, for example by showing them this notice, and have their agreement (for children, that of whoever has parental responsibility): you declare this with the same box. They can also ask us at any time to delete them, by writing to the contact in section 1.

Only write them in that section, not in the free-text notes: if you write them there or send them to us some other way without consent, we delete them. The allergies and intolerances you write are used only to cook for you: Evelyn sees them, in her private area, and, when needed, so does whoever runs the system on her behalf, only for technical support and under a duty of confidentiality (section 7). They are not shared with third parties and never appear in emails or automatic messages: the email alert to Evelyn only says whether you listed any, never which ones (section 6). We keep them like the request you wrote them in (section 8).

You can withdraw your consent at any time by writing to the contact in section 1: we delete your allergies and intolerances, including from requests already sent, and without them Evelyn may not be able to cook for you safely. Withdrawal does not make earlier processing unlawful.
privacy.flowTitle: 6. How the data reaches us and where it is stored
privacy.flowBody:
When you press “Send the request”, the form data travels encrypted (HTTPS) to our system on Supabase, with servers in the European Union (Frankfurt, Germany), where it is stored. Evelyn gets an email alert, which says whether there are allergies but never which ones, and sees the full request in her private area, protected by a personal login.

While you are still filling in the form, to show you on the calendar the days when Evelyn is free, the site asks the same system for them: this look-up carries only the estimated length of the service, worked out from the number of people, days and meals, and no other form data. In the same way the site loads the menu dishes, with their descriptions, from the system: this look-up carries no form data at all.

Together with each week's menu, which Evelyn sends you by email or on WhatsApp, you get a personal link to your booking page. The link contains a code that opens your booking: our system keeps only its fingerprint (hash), and after 15 days the link stops working. The page shows the weeks, the menu for each one, the quote (the dates and the service price) and your name, never your address or allergies. When you accept or decline the quote, confirm the menu or ask for changes, your reply travels encrypted to the same system and Evelyn gets an email alert that doesn't include your message: she reads it in her private area.

We send the confirmation email through Resend, like the menu email and the alerts to Evelyn. About allergies, it only repeats your confirmation that nobody has any, if you gave it: it never says whether you listed any. If you choose to get the confirmation on WhatsApp too, the message goes through Meta's WhatsApp Business platform; if you don't choose it, we won't message you on WhatsApp to confirm the request.

To stop spam and automated submissions, the form uses Cloudflare Turnstile, which automatically checks that a person is filling it in: to do so it processes your IP address and some technical information about your browser and device, only to recognise bots and not to profile you. For the same reason we count, for each IP address, the requests sent, the calendar and menu look-ups, and the visits and replies on the booking page: we keep the address only as a fingerprint (hash), never in clear, for no more than 2 days.
privacy.recipientsBody:
• Supabase (Supabase Pte. Ltd., Singapore): database and system that receives the requests, with servers in the European Union (Frankfurt).
  • Resend (Plus Five Five, Inc., United States): sending the confirmation, menu and alert emails, which it stores in the United States.
  • Cloudflare (Cloudflare, Inc., United States): website hosting (Cloudflare Pages) and the Turnstile spam check. To improve bot detection, Cloudflare also uses this technical data as an independent controller, under its own Turnstile privacy addendum.
  • Meta (WhatsApp Ireland Limited): only if you choose the WhatsApp confirmation or when we message each other on WhatsApp.
  • A trusted technician who runs the system on Evelyn's behalf: technical support, only when needed and under a duty of confidentiality.
  • If you pay by card or Satispay, the payment data is processed directly by the payment provider.
  • The accountant (commercialista), for tax documents, if the service takes place.
  • The authorities, only when required by law.

These providers process data on our behalf, as processors (Art. 28 GDPR). Supabase, Resend and Cloudflare are based outside the European Union (Singapore and the United States), and some data may also be processed there, for example the emails sent or the providers' technical support: the transfer relies on the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission and, for Resend and Cloudflare, also on their certification under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework. The allergies and intolerances you write are not shared with third parties and no email includes them: the alert to Evelyn, sent through Resend, only says whether you listed any, never which ones (section 6).
privacy.retentionBody:
• Requests that don't turn into a service: we delete them, together with the allergies and intolerances in them, 90 days after the same person's last request. We delete the related emails and chats by hand within the following 30 days.
  • IP address fingerprints (hashes) used for the limits on submissions, calendar and menu look-ups, and visits and replies on the booking page: 2 days at most.
  • Clients: for the duration of the relationship; allergies and intolerances like the request you wrote them in, unless you withdraw consent sooner.
  • Quote and menu replies and booking page links: like the booking they belong to (the link stops working after 15 days).
  • Tax documents: 10 years, as required by law.
privacy.cookiesBody:
This website uses no profiling cookies and no analytics tools, and shows no advertising. It only stores, in your browser's memory, the language you choose: it is not sent to anyone and you can delete it from your browser settings.

On the request page, the Cloudflare Turnstile spam check collects the technical data described in section 6, for security purposes only: to tell people from bots it may use strictly necessary technical cookies and browser storage, with no profiling or advertising.
privacy.rightsBody:
At any time you can ask us to access your data, correct it, erase it, restrict its processing, receive it in a readable format (portability) or object to the processing (Arts. 15-22 GDPR). You can also withdraw the consents you gave us: for WhatsApp and for allergies and intolerances (section 5). Write to the contact in section 1: we reply within one month.

We don't make decisions based solely on automated processing: Evelyn prepares the quote by hand.
privacy.complaintBody: If you believe the processing does not comply with the GDPR, you can lodge a complaint with the Italian data protection authority, the Garante per la protezione dei dati personali (www.garanteprivacy.it).
privacy.requiredTitle: 12. Do I have to give you my data?
privacy.requiredBody: Name, area, phone and email are needed to prepare your quote and confirm your request: without them we can't reply. You also need to answer the allergy question, either confirming that nobody has any or writing them down with your consent: without that answer the form won't send your request. If you'd rather not give your consent on the form, use the contact in section 1 (section 5). Notes, menu dishes and the WhatsApp confirmation are optional. Replying to the quote and the menu on your booking page is optional too: you can write to Evelyn directly.

notices.declined: You've declined the quote: we've let {chef} know.
notices.alreadyDeclined: You had already declined this quote.
notices.outdated: {chef} has sent you a newer version of the quote: here it is.
notices.changesRequested: You'd asked for changes: {chef} will send you the updated quote.
notices.changed: {chef} has just changed the quote and will send you the new version.
notices.closedAccepted: This quote had already been accepted.
notices.closedDeclined: You had already declined this quote.
notices.closedWithdrawn: We couldn't record your answer: this quote had already been withdrawn.
notices.closedExpired: We couldn't record your answer: the time to accept it had already run out.
notices.unavailable: This quote is no longer available. Your updated booking is below.
notices.empty: This quote no longer has any weeks to accept. Write to {chef}.
notices.goneBooked: We couldn't record your answer to the quote: in the meantime, {chef} confirmed your booking directly. If you have any questions, write to {chef}.
notices.goneReplaced: We couldn't record your answer: in the meantime, {chef} sent you a new quote, which you'll find below.

captcha.metaDescription: Technical page that completes the anti-spam check when signing in to the {brand} app: the app opens it, there is no need to visit it.
captcha.title: Anti-spam check
captcha.interactive: Tap the box to confirm you are a person.
captcha.noscript: JavaScript is needed to complete the anti-spam check: turn it on in your browser.
captcha.standalone: This page only serves the {brand} app to complete the anti-spam check when signing in. You can close it.
